title: Realization decisions
situation: The operator is sometimes confident how a concept should be realized. Concepts name no implementation, so that conviction had no place to go except prose in a brief, which is lost when a session compacts, and nothing carried it through to judgment.
decision: A conviction about realization is sorted into three layers. What anyone can observe becomes an example. An internal choice that matters becomes an accepted decision with its reason, which is the constraint itself. An internal choice that does not matter stays with the lead. The lead receives the accepted decisions that constrain its cut, and the assayers judge the work against them as well as against the concepts and examples.
consequences: decision, lead and judgment are superseded to carry this. Decisions 0009 and 0017 were already this kind of constraint.
